versions.changelog:
Initial release of atomic-code-generator:

- Provides atomic function decomposition for code generation, splitting complex features into atomic methods with complete code.
- Default output shows only the method invocation structure; users can request full code display.
- Covers 6 domains and 30 task types with a layered methodology structure.
- Outlines a unified, step-by-step execution workflow from analysis to delivery.
- Enforces factual discipline: no data fabrication, strict standard compliance, and true atomicity in method breakdown.
